canonicalization.numeric_tokens: retain in exact normalization; replace ISO dates, clock times, and standalone numeric values with typed tokens for template signatures

template_signature.rule: Canonical text with date/time/count/duration tokens abstracted; equality is a rejection.
template_signature.entity_replacement_rule: If the remaining clause skeleton is equal after named food, equipment, weekday, or exercise-entity substitution, reject as same scenario structure.

semantic_candidate_detection.rule: Flag candidate pairs when token Jaccard similarity is at least 0.45 and at least three non-stopword tokens overlap, or when a shared outcome/invariant signature is paired with the same request structure.
semantic_candidate_detection.disposition: Human review is required; a flagged pair is never silently accepted.

acceptance_freeze_rule: No exact, normalized, template, structure, or confirmed semantic development overlap; every flagged semantic candidate has recorded human disposition.
